meta: What do the photos you post reveal: one proud photo of your child can reveal their school, class and pickup time.

muc.title: A proud parent photo
muc.text: One proud photo of your child on the first day of school can reveal their school, class and pickup time.

muc.title: Things that give you away
muc.text: Watch for house numbers, license plates, name badges, boarding passes, and even the view out the window showing where you live.

muc.title: A photo checklist
muc.text: Ask a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, for a checklist of revealing details, then check your photos yourself before posting.

muc.title: Post after you're home
muc.text: Post travel photos after you return, because posting right away tells strangers your home is empty.

muc.title: Check your last three photos
muc.text: Open the last three photos you posted, check them against the list, and blur or remove anything that gives too much away.
